description: This Java class handles the command for assigning roles to groups in the Fineract system. It implements a handler interface, processes a command, and invokes the relevant service to create a role assignment.

classes.name: AssignRoleCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles command processing for assigning roles to groups, marked with the @Service annotation and mapped to the 'GROUP' entity with 'ASSIGNROLE' action.

methods.name: AssignRoleCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupRolesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the assign role command by delegating to the GroupRolesWritePlatformService's createRole method within a transactional context.
